provenance.asset_description: Two separate character art illustrations over a blurred purple background. The image on the left is of Kizrech, a muscular agender vordine devil stands in full Hellish armor, with a large greatsword over their shoulder. They have an impressive moustache, under the character is the pathfinder society text logo. The illustration on the right is a monstrous and muscular orocoran with pallid skin, a fleshy proboscis, and a quatrefoil mouth stands tall in black armor, wielding a large gun. Above the character art is the Starfinder society text logo.
